change.summary: Skip Luxium 2.8.0's first-run alpha warning gate on JEM clients.

modifiers.before: Luxium opens AlphaWarningScreen over the first title screen, disables Continue for 200 ticks and requires acknowledgement.
modifiers.after: JEM Luxium reports the exact alpha warning as not eligible, so startup proceeds directly to the ordinary JEM title screen.

rationale.purpose: Prevent every new JEM client from seeing a ten-second third-party pre-menu gate while preserving the actual Luxium controls.

introduced.summary: Disable the exact Luxium alpha warning eligibility check.

history.summary: Disable the exact Luxium alpha warning eligibility check.

notes: The Luxium settings screen, Embeddium page, renderer state, Oculus compatibility and YouTube action remain unchanged.
unresolved: Fresh-profile runtime startup remains pending because no client launch was authorized.
